<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- onboarding illustration -->
  <g opacity="0.98">
    <rect x="28" y="121" width="334" height="306" rx="18" fill="#131313"/>
    <rect x="44" y="140" width="286" height="160" rx="14" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <rect x="44" y="140" width="286" height="160" rx="14" fill="#101010"/>
    <rect x="58" y="154" width="258" height="132" rx="12" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="58" y="154" width="258" height="132" rx="12" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
    <circle cx="296" cy="176" r="18" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <rect x="278" y="176" width="8" height="36" rx="4" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <rect x="296" y="176" width="8" height="36" rx="4" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <rect x="285" y="210" width="28" height="58" rx="14" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <rect x="304" y="194" width="16" height="58" rx="8" fill="#B1060F"/>
    <circle cx="138" cy="200" r="30" fill="#2B2B2B"/>
    <circle cx="138" cy="200" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF1A"/>
    <circle cx="138" cy="200" r="12" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <rect x="96" y="236" width="94" height="28" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF1A"/>
    <rect x="120" y="242" width="46" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF82"/>
    <rect x="72" y="328" width="246" height="18" rx="9" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <rect x="72" y="328" width="142" height="18" rx="9" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="360" r="12" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="360" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="112" y="352" width="176" height="16" rx="8" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <rect x="112" y="352" width="92" height="16" rx="8" fill="#585858"/>
    <rect x="72" y="388" width="246" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF1A"/>
    <rect x="72" y="388" width="66" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <polygon points="198,178 216,166 216,190" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="44" y="140" width="286" height="160" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF1A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- logo -->
  <g transform="translate(31, 61)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="24" fill="none"/>
    <text x="0" y="18" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#EE1520">NETFLIX</text>
  </g>

  <!-- help link -->
  <text x="334" y="80" text-anchor="end" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Help</text>

  <!-- main copy -->
  <g transform="translate(31, 478)">
    <text x="0" y="0" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Watch on any device</text>
    <text x="0" y="32" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Stream on your phone, tablet, laptop, and TV</text>
    <text x="0" y="56" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">without paying more. Pick up where you left off</text>
    <text x="0" y="80" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">on any screen.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- page indicator dots -->
  <g transform="translate(158, 706)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="16" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="32" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="0" r="4.5" fill="#737373"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sign in button -->
  <g transform="translate(17, 745)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="356" height="44" rx="2" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <text x="178" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g transform="translate(0, 0)">
    <text x="23" y="27" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(314, 16)" fill="#FFFFFF">
      <rect x="0" y="8" width="3" height="6" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="5" y="6" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="10" y="4" width="3" height="10" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="15" y="2" width="3" height="12" rx="1"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(336, 16)" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <circle cx="10" cy="8" r="3.5"/>
      <line x1="10" y1="8" x2="13.5" y2="5"/>
      <line x1="15" y1="6.5" x2="18" y2="6.5"/>
      <line x1="15" y1="9.5" x2="19" y2="9.5"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(356, 16)">
      <rect x="0" y="4" width="24" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="24" y="7.5" width="2.5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="2.5" y="6" width="15.5" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom nav -->
  <g transform="translate(0, 784)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="60" fill="#000000"/>
    <g transform="translate(28, 10)" opacity="0.95">
      <polygon points="12,0 24,8 0,8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(112, 10)" opacity="0.5">
      <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="16" x2="24" y2="22" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Search</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(186, 10)" opacity="0.5">
      <rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="6,6 16,10 6,14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Downloads</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(258, 10)" opacity="0.5">
      <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="14" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">More</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(326, 10)" opacity="0.5">
      <rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="6" y="8" width="12" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="6" y="12" width="8" height="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Info</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- required 4 path elements -->
  <path d="M58 177 L72 177 L65 188 Z" fill="#EE1520"/>
  <path d="M118 257 L130 257 L124 244 Z" fill="#B1060F"/>
  <path d="M245 244 L257 244 L251 232 Z" fill="#EE1520"/>
  <path d="M264 361 L274 351 L284 361 Z" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
